Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

PERCEPTIONx 0.4.0

New features

  • read_10x() reads a CellRanger output folder, a .h5 file, or the three files passed explicitly, and returns the sparse genes x cells matrix that preprocess_sc() expects. The Shiny upload path now calls this function, so app users and package users share one 10x reader instead of the app owning a private copy.
  • preprocess_sc() implements the full raw-counts to clone-label workflow: MAD-based per-patient quality control, normalisation, variable-feature selection, a shared PCA embedding, and clustering. cluster_scope = "global" (default) clusters all cells together, as in the original PERCEPTION method, so a clone id can occur in several patients; cluster_scope = "patient" clusters inside each patient only, so a clone can never span two patients. The two are identical for a single-patient dataset. With the patient scope, harmony is applied inside a patient that has more than one sample (e.g. longitudinal biopsies) so a batch effect cannot split one clone in two; harmony is optional and the step is skipped with a warning when absent.
  • preprocess_sc() gains skip_qc = FALSE. With skip_qc = TRUE the MAD fences are not applied and every cell is kept, which reproduces the original PERCEPTION pipeline on an already-curated matrix; the QC table still reports the input but marks the fences as off.
  • plot_qc_report() draws the per-patient QC fences, so the automatic filtering can be audited without knowing the MAD rule.
  • prepare_data() gains two alternative inputs. data = <Seurat object> reads the matrix from assay/layer and labels from clone_col or Idents(); clone_labels = <data.frame> takes a pre-computed cell-to-clone table. Both skip clustering.
  • prepare_data() now records where the clone labels came from in $label_source: auto_cluster, user_labels, seurat_idents, seurat_metadata, or provided_matrix_columns.
  • preprocess_sc() gains remove_doublets = FALSE: when enabled, cells classified as doublets by scDblFinder are removed after QC, one patient at a time. Doublets pass every QC fence (normal gene counts and mitochondrial fraction) yet can form a spurious clone made of two fused clones. scDblFinder and SingleCellExperiment are optional (Suggests); without them the step warns and is skipped. Removed cells are returned in $doublet_cells and counted in qc$n_doublet_removed.
  • preprocess_sc() gains exclude_markers / exclude_min_expr: cells that strongly express a user-supplied marker set are removed before clustering, so immune and stromal populations do not form clusters that later read as resistance clones. This is an exclusion rule, not a tumour-cell classifier. Default NULL keeps every cell. Removed cells are returned in $excluded_cells.
  • confidence in preprocess_sc() output is renamed cluster_size_class (large / small), because it only describes cluster size and says nothing about how credible a clone is.

Improvements

  • The MAD fence default is now nmads = 5 (was 3). Benchmarked against CellRanger’s own cell calls on real unfiltered matrices: PBMC 3k Jaccard 0.914 -> 0.969, lung squamous carcinoma 0.711 -> 0.806, precision unchanged in both. On the labelled Maynard cohort the patient-level AUC returns to the no-QC value (0.821) instead of dropping to 0.750, i.e. QC stops deleting real tumour cells.
  • Mitochondrial genes are now detected when row names are Ensembl IDs (10x GRCh38 features.tsv column 1, many GEO uploads). Previously the MT- prefix never matched, so pct_mito was silently 0 and the mitochondrial fence did nothing.
  • prepare_data(data = <Seurat>) now reads the counts layer by default and falls back to data, matching what the app does on upload. Before, the package default was data, so the Seurat path averaged log-normalised values while the raw-counts path averaged counts. Pass layer = "data" to keep the old behaviour.
  • prepare_data() now accepts the output of preprocess_sc() on its own: the patient column of clone_labels supplies the patient grouping, so patient_mapping can be omitted, and the unfiltered matrix can be passed directly because unlabelled cells (removed by QC) are dropped with an informational message instead of an error.
  • prepare_data() also accepts patient and clone IDs as plain vectors (patient_mapping = my_patients, clone_col = my_clones), so a Seurat object does not need those columns in its metadata. While adding this, a bug was fixed where the clone-level refinement overwrote Seurat-derived clone labels with matrix column names.
  • DepMap now caches under tools::R_user_dir("PERCEPTIONx", "cache"), the platform cache directory, instead of the roaming user data directory. It is a regenerable 567 MB download, so it should not be synced or backed up with user data. A copy found in the old location is moved on first use rather than downloaded again.
  • Internal code migrated to data.table; user-facing results remain data.frame.
  • Messages and errors use cli; run_seurat_pipeline() and its lifecycle dependency were removed in favour of prepare_data() and the shared cluster_embedding() core.
  • Drug catalogues are exported as documented objects: perception_depmap_drugs, perception_fda_approved_drugs, perception_all_drugs.
  • glmnet and randomForest remain in Imports: caret::train(method = "glmnet") is the default path and loads them at runtime.
  • Matrix added to Imports; harmony added to Suggests.
  • Added air formatting, jarl linting, spelling checks, and repository templates (CONTRIBUTING / SUPPORT / CODE_OF_CONDUCT).

PERCEPTIONx 0.3.0

New features

  • Help tab gained a “Supported Drugs” catalogue: the full ~1,450-compound DepMap screen with the 44 pre-trained models marked, filterable by Pre-trained / Demo / All compounds with debounced search.
  • New guided walkthroughs on the Help tab (Demo and Advanced tours) with retaken, correctly-sized screenshots.
  • Reworked the Advanced tour steps: three input files, Seurat clustering, pre-trained vs. trained models, training output, prediction and visualisation reading order.

Improvements

  • README, vignettes and tutorial sections rearranged and synced with the app.

PERCEPTIONx 0.2.0

New features

  • Redesigned the visualization tab as a “plot gallery”: all 7 plot types visible as clickable cards, a data-readiness bar showing what is loaded, and click-to-draw (no Generate button). Parameter changes (drug / gene / ROC pair) redraw the plot automatically; hovering a card previews its description before you commit; generated-at timestamps are shown in UTC.
  • Seurat clustering now reports live stage progress (normalizing / variable features / PCA / clustering / UMAP / …) in the Load Demo overlay.
  • Demo data is more realistic and reproducible: tumor-heterogeneity mixing (responder/non-responder cells mixed 65/35 per patient) brings the ROC AUC from a perfect 1.0 to ~0.86, tighter noise-gene range sharpens the UMAP clone layout, and a fixed seed makes every Load Demo identical.
  • Layout widths unified across Train / Predict / Visualize (sidebar ratio 4:8); Data readiness order now groups the three user-uploaded inputs first.
  • annotate_clones() / prepare_data() gained an optional progress_cb and a variable_selection option (vst default; dispersion/mvp for speed).

Bug fixes

  • Background workers could not start in container deployments (“Failed to start the background worker … invalid connection”). Spawning now tries a ladder of progressively simpler callr configs (supervise + stderr file -> /dev/null -> inherited stdio) and reports rich diagnostics on final failure.
  • stdout = FALSE was rejected with EACCES in the rocker/shiny-verse container; stdout now redirects to /dev/null instead.
  • Removed closeAllConnections() from the Shiny session-end callback; it corrupted the process connection table and killed later spawns.
  • DepMap load no longer disconnects the session; demo load failures fixed.
  • Clearing demo data now also drops stale predictions; invalid expression files are rejected up front.
  • ROC curve corners (0,0) / (1,1) no longer render as a broken line (smoothed coords are densified onto a uniform FPR grid).
  • ROC / boxplot defaulted to the first drug on first click instead of the selected “Combination” (selectize init race); Gene Expression no longer shows “Select a gene first” on first draw.
  • DepMap cache is never auto-expired on disk (removed the TTL cleanup that could delete a 567 MB pre-downloaded cache); cache_ttl_hours <= 0 no longer deletes the file immediately.
  • Removed a stray inst/shiny/app/FALSE binary file from the repository.

Changes

  • Removed the on-disk TTL mechanism for the DepMap cache; memory is instead released by the master worker’s idle timeout.

PERCEPTIONx 0.1.0

Initial release.
